needs: A rule table for how many more creatures a permanent can block (CR 509.1a), including any number, read as blockers are declared.

A standing rule that a creature assigns no combat damage (CR 510.1), apart from the one-shot effect of a resolving ability.

api: CardDef::combat_groups: &[CombatGroupRule { role, applies, counted, others_only, count }]

needs: A standing rule that a creature blocks each combat if able (CR 509.1c), which today only an effect on one object can say.
A standing goad from a static ability (CR 701.38), which today only a resolving effect can make.
A rule letting a creature attack a matching defender as though it had haste, apart from activation (CR 302.6).
A rule that a creature can be blocked as though it lacked an evasion ability (CR 509.1b).
A rule that a tapped creature can block (CR 509.1a).
A cost to block (CR 509.1d), which Cantrip has only for attacking.
A cost to attack that isn't mana, such as sacrificing a land or paying with a counter (CR 508.1d), since attack_costs returns a ManaCost.
The exert attack option with no linked trigger, for cards whose exert pays off through "whenever you exert a creature" (CR 701.43).
Mana restricted by a filter on the spell or source it pays for, past the closed list ManaRestriction::NAMED has words for (CR 106.6).

A duration ending as a player's next upkeep begins (CR 611.2a).
A duration ending as the next end step begins (CR 611.2a).
A duration a player may end at any time they have priority by paying a cost, as a special action (the licids, CR 116.2).

An effect that all creatures able to block a creature do so (CR 509.1c), the Lure effect made by a resolving ability.
An effect that a creature blocks each attacker if able (CR 509.1c), with its block limit raised apart.

An effect that a creature can block more creatures (CR 509.1a), including any number.

A hook that chooses which player a permanent enters under the control of, chosen before its other replacements (CR 616.1b), which CardDef::enters must not do.
